plan.sourceName: FormularyNavigator New Jersey Medicaid machine-readable feed

batches.method: Ingredient-level exact matching against the live public JSON feed (170,121 NDC rows). Flags are conservative: where PA/QL encoding applied only to outlier variants (for example 40 mg delayed-release doxycycline or ER osmotic metformin), the flag is omitted from flags and the nuance is captured in the product note.
Deterministic text-layer extraction of the official PDF; only exact ingredient/product rows promoted.
